title: Add Suggestions API + funnel Grafana dashboards and beta alerting
author: Aisha Bello
description: Summary: Adds a first-pass set of Grafana dashboards + alert rules for the Optimization Suggestions beta, covering (1) Suggestions API health (latency/errors/payload) and (2) the Suggestions view funnel (impression → expand → dismiss → apply-click), including breakdowns by org/model/route/region with conservative cardinality controls. Motivation: during dogfood we had a p95 regression + early customer reports of “empty despite traffic” and “estimates look off”; we need a single place for SRE/Platform + product to validate the pipeline (compute freshness), the API (error/latency), and the UX funnel (are people seeing/using suggestions). Scope notes: This PR only adds dashboards/alerts in observability-pack; it assumes the backend/UI already emits the metrics/events (ENG-19402) and the Suggestions API exists (ENG-19341). No changes to application code here. Dashboards added: (A) Optimize / Suggestions API Health: request rate, p50/p95 latency, 4xx/5xx, top error codes, payload size, cache hit/miss (if available), and per-route hot spots. Includes links to the runbook for triage. (B) Optimize / Suggestions Funnel (Beta): counts + conversion rates for suggestions_impression, suggestions_row_expand, suggestions_dismiss, suggestions_apply_click; time series + cohort table, with optional filters (org_id, project_id, model, route, region) and a “minimum volume” guardrail. (C) Optimize / Suggestions Compute Freshness: staleness/lag from the compute job (stale_as_of age), recompute success/failure, and lag percentiles so support can tell if “insufficient telemetry” is real vs pipeline delay. Alerting: Adds lightweight beta alert rules with conservative thresholds and paging only on clear system issues. SuggestionsAPIHigh5xxRate (page): 5xx > 1% for 10m (per env) with a minimum request volume gate. SuggestionsAPIP95LatencyHigh (page): p95 > 350ms for 15m (same volume gate). SuggestionsComputeLagHigh (page): compute freshness lag p95 > 6h for 30m. SuggestionsEventIngestionDrop (ticket): impressions drop to ~0 while API request volume is non-zero (helps catch client-side event pipeline breaks). All alerts include runbook links and labels for routing to eng-sre/eng-platform. Privacy/cardinality: Funnel breakdowns use org_id/project_id (numeric/UUID) and do not include org name; we cap table panels to top-N by volume and add a $__min_volume variable to reduce noisy / low-signal slices. Notes for rollout: Dashboards are safe to merge before the beta flag expands; alerts should be enabled in staging immediately and in prod with “ticket” severity for 24h before paging (see checklist).
commits: Add suggestions API health dashboard (latency/errors/payload panels)
Add suggestions funnel dashboard (events + conversion panels, filters, top-N tables)
Add compute freshness dashboard (stale_as_of lag + job outcomes)
Add alert rules for suggestions API + compute lag + event ingestion drop
Wire dashboards into mixin/provisioning and docs links
review_conversation: Allison Grant (review): The dashboards look good, but we need to be careful with cardinality on the funnel breakdown panels. Can we (1) default to no org_id breakdown, (2) cap top-N to 20, and (3) add a minimum volume guard to prevent noisy slices? Also please ensure no org names appear anywhere in queries/legends.

Aisha Bello (author): Updated funnel dashboard: top-N tables capped to 20, added $__min_volume (default 200 events/24h) and moved org_id/project_id breakdown into an opt-in row. Queries use org_id/project_id only (no slugs/names).

Sean Gallagher (review): Alert thresholds: p95>300ms might be too tight given we’ve seen cold-cache spikes; can we bump to 350ms and require >50 rpm to page? Also add runbook links in annotations/labels.
Aisha Bello (author): Done. p95 threshold set to 350ms for 15m, added min volume gates (requests_per_min > 50) for both latency + 5xx alerts. Runbook links added to annotations.

Logan Wright (review): For the ingestion drop alert, check the metric source. If we’re using UI event counts from the analytics pipeline, it can lag. Make the severity ticket-only and compare vs API request volume to avoid false positives.

Aisha Bello (author): Adjusted ingestion drop alert to ticket severity, gating on non-zero API request volume and a 30m window; description notes analytics lag and points to compute freshness dashboard for correlation.

Dylan Brooks (review): Can we add a panel to correlate API 5xx spikes with error_code/status_code and a link to the suggestions API triage runbook? This was missing when we debugged the last p95 regression.
Aisha Bello (author): Added “Top error codes (5xx)” panel and dashboard link-out to the triage runbook section. Also added a small annotation row with deploy markers (where available).
Allison Grant (approval): Approved with the cardinality guardrails. Please keep an eye on query cost in prod once enabled.
Sean Gallagher (approval): Approved. Let’s enable prod alerts as ticket-only for 24h then promote to paging.
release_notes: Internal: Added Grafana dashboards + beta alerting for Optimize Suggestions (API health, compute freshness, and UI funnel).
